title: 第5章 叶氏宗族退婚第6章 他们刚退我们上去又结
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
云水城，天香国四大主城之一，位于王都的东方。
这里除了是拱卫王都的主城之外，更是顶尖大族萧家的根据地。
此时，云水城人来人往的繁华街道之上，一行五人正行走在大街上。
叶青山忍不住发问，“爹，我们真的不考虑一下让天儿认祖归宗吗？”
闻言，叶雄风脸色一沉，却并未说出责怪的话语，反倒是轻微一叹。
“从他们将我们一家子从王都中赶出来的时候，叶氏宗族便与我们白枫城叶家再无瓜葛。”
说到此，他眼神一黯，“青山，别忘记你母亲究竟是怎么死的。”
身后跟着的叶青志和叶青山身躯一颤，不再多言。
而叶天澜则是被母亲紧紧抱在怀中，颇为好奇的看着三名长辈之间的对话。
这还是他第一次从大人口中听说有关那位未曾谋面奶奶的事情。
天香国很大，再加上需要照顾尚且为婴儿的叶天澜，几人一路上从白枫城赶过来足足花费了大半个月的时间。
为了精简出行，几人也没有带上叶家其余的护卫队成员，有三名通窍境武者已经足够应对绝大部分的问题了。
倘若有先天层次的高手出手刻意对付他们的话，那就算再叫上其他人也只是多几个送菜的。
根据叶天澜从只言片语中了解到的信息，已经得知这个武道世界的境界从下到上划分为——
锻体，开脉，聚气，通窍，先天，御空，轮海，真灵···
真灵之上还有境界存在，但是当达到武道真灵层次，已经在气海中凝聚出武魂真灵之后，这种武者就足以称之为陆地神仙了。
移山填海，腾云起雾对于他们来说通通都不在话下。
这大半个月来，叶天澜的境界速度相较于之前慢了不止一筹，才堪堪打通了第三条主经脉。
不过这也是没有办法的事情，经脉的打通越到后面便越难。
因为从外界吸入的元气终究只是外来的力量，散乱且微弱。

想要打通之后堵塞的经脉，就必须沿着之前打通的经脉先流转过去。
就跟疏通水管一样。
可这股外来的力量终究是有限的，当它运转的长度足够长之后就会在过程中不可避免的产生磨损消耗，也就会导致后劲渐渐的不足。
自然越到后期，打通的经脉越来越长之后，冲击经脉的速度也就会越来越慢。
除非是受到外界强大力量的刺激，否则这只会是一个日积月累的水磨功夫过程。
这也是通脉境足以困住绝大多数人一辈子的原因，近乎有九成武者都沦陷于此。
没有资源的人就更不用多说了。
按照常理来说，武者想要踏入下一个聚气境界，只需要在体内凝集出元气打通十二条主经脉就够了。
也就是所谓的手三阴经、手三阳经、足三阳经和足三阴经。
而叶天澜所接触的人中，无论是叶家护卫队的人还是大伯二伯，自己老爹，以及爷爷全都是以基础十二主经脉踏入的聚气层次。
这并非他们不想以更高的上限打通经脉跨入下一个层次。
content_en:
Yunshui City, one of the four main cities of Tianxiang Kingdom, is located to the east of the royal capital.
In addition to being the main city that defends the royal capital, this place is also the base of the Xiao family, a top family.
At this time, a group of five people were walking on the bustling streets of Yunshui City.
Ye Qingshan couldn't help but ask, "Dad, do we really not want to consider letting Tian'er recognize his ancestor and return to the clan?"
Hearing this, Ye Xiongfeng's face darkened, but he did not say any words of blame. Instead, he sighed slightly.
"Ever since they drove our family out of the royal capital, the Ye family has nothing to do with our Ye family in Bai Maple City."
At this point, his eyes darkened, "Qingshan, don't forget how your mother died."
Ye Qingzhi and Ye Qingshan, who were following behind, trembled and said no more.
Ye Tianlan, on the other hand, was held tightly in his mother's arms and watched the conversation between the three elders with curiosity.
This was the first time he heard about the grandma he had never met from an adult.
Tianxiang Country is very big, and with the need to take care of Ye Tianlan, who is still an infant, it took them more than half a month to come all the way from Bai Maple City.
In order to streamline their travel, they did not take the rest of the Ye family's escorts with them. Three Tongqiao realm warriors were enough to deal with most problems.
If there are innate-level experts who deliberately deal with them, then even if they call in other people, they will just be a few more food delivery people.
According to the information Ye Tianlan learned from a few words, he has learned that the realm of this martial arts world is divided from bottom to top -
Strengthen the body, open the pulse, gather energy, clear the orifices, innate, control the sky, wheel and sea, true spirit...
There are still realms above the true spirit, but when one reaches the level of the true spirit of martial arts and has condensed the true spirit of martial arts in the sea of qi, such a warrior is enough to be called a land god.
Moving mountains and filling seas, soaring clouds and creating fog are no problem for them.
In the past half month, Ye Tianlan's state speed has slowed down more than before, and he has finally opened up the third main meridian.
However, there is nothing that can be done about it. The further the meridians are opened, the more difficult it becomes.
Because the vitality breathed in from the outside world is ultimately just external force, scattered and weak.
If you want to open the meridians that are blocked later, you must first flow along the meridians that were opened before.
Just like unblocking a water pipe.
But this external force is limited after all. When it runs long enough, it will inevitably produce wear and tear in the process, which will also lead to a gradual lack of stamina.
Naturally, in the later stages, when the meridians opened become longer and longer, the speed of impacting the meridians will become slower and slower.
Unless it is stimulated by strong external forces, this will only be a grinding process that accumulates over time.
This is also the reason why Tongmai Realm is enough to trap most people for a lifetime. Almost 90% of warriors fall here.
Not to mention those without resources.
According to common sense, if a warrior wants to step into the next level of Qi gathering, he only needs to condense the vitality in his body and open up the twelve main meridians.
They are the so-called three yin meridians of the hands, the three yang meridians of the hands, the three yang meridians of the feet, and the three yin meridians of the feet.
Among the people Ye Tianlan came into contact with, whether they were members of the Ye family's escort team, his eldest uncle, his father, or his grandfather, all of them had entered the Qi gathering level based on the basic twelve main meridians.
This is not because they don’t want to open up the meridians with a higher ceiling and move to the next level.
